import openpyxl, os, re
from openpyxl.utils.cell import range_boundaries

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/57317/1_57317_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/57317_0_00acbf8b/1_57317_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
data_ws = wb["Data"]
find_ws = wb["Find"]

# Locate the Product and Customer columns in the Data sheet by their headers.
header_row = None
product_col = None
customer_col = None
for row in data_ws.iter_rows():
    vals = [cell.value for cell in row]
    if "Product" in vals and "Customer" in vals:
        header_row = row[0].row
        product_col = vals.index("Product") + 1
        customer_col = vals.index("Customer") + 1
        break

# Locate the lookup product in the Find sheet: it is the cell immediately
# to the left of the "Customer" header used for the returned customer list.
lookup_product = None
output_header_row = None
output_col = None
for row in find_ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        if cell.value == "Customer":
            output_header_row = cell.row
            output_col = cell.column
            left_val = find_ws.cell(cell.row, cell.column - 1).value if cell.column > 1 else None
            if left_val not in (None, ""):
                lookup_product = left_val
                break
    if lookup_product is not None:
        break

# Collect all customers whose product matches the lookup value.
matches = []
if header_row is not None and product_col is not None and customer_col is not None and lookup_product is not None:
    for r in range(header_row + 1, data_ws.max_row + 1):
        if data_ws.cell(r, product_col).value == lookup_product:
            matches.append(data_ws.cell(r, customer_col).value)

# Fill only the requested answer cells.  The full spill/list begins on the row
# below the "Customer" header, so B5 receives the second matching customer, etc.
answer_range = "'Find'!B5:B9"
cell_range = answer_range.split("!", 1)[1].replace("'", "")
min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(cell_range)

start_row = (output_header_row + 1) if output_header_row is not None else min_row
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    idx = r - start_row
    value = matches[idx] if 0 <= idx < len(matches) else None
    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        find_ws.cell(r, c).value = value

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
